'''Telak's Terrors''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group led by [[Kird Telak]]. They operated out of a [[Telak's Terrors Base|base]] on [[Seltaya Minor]] in the [[Ropagi system/Legends|Ropagi system]], and had developed their own ship design, the [[KT 1A-Telak]].
